actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: The environment Isaac-Libero-Franka-IK-v0 is registered with entry_point isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv and env_cfg_entry_point IKLiberoCameraEnvCfg
IKLiberoCameraEnvCfg is defined in franka_libero_env_cfg.py and extends JointPositionLiberoCameraEnvCfg
The IK arm action is a differential-inverse-kinematics pose command with ik_method dls and scale 1.0
The default gripper action is a binary joint-position action whose open command is 0.04 and close command is 0.0 for the panda_finger joints
The policy observation group contains the last action, the end-effector pose in the robot base frame, the gripper position and the 7D Franka arm joint positions, with concatenate_terms False
The subtask observation group adds one grasp flag for every object of interest
The simulation advances 1/60 s of physics per simulation step with decimation 3, so one environment step is 0.05 s (20 Hz), and the libero_10 episode length is 16.0 s
Policy observations are synchronized at 20 Hz
The commands, rewards and curriculum managers are None, so the configured environment has no reward function of its own
The terminations are time_out, one object_dropped term per object of interest below -0.05 m and the task goal success term
The eye-in-hand and agentview cameras are 512 by 512 with rgb and distance_to_image_plane data
The task JSON is selected by TASK_SUITE (default libero_10) and TASK_ID (default 0) under benchmarks/datasets/libero/config, and the USD assets come from LIBERO_ASSETS_DATA_DIR
The closed-loop policy client creates the environment with gym.make(env_name, cfg=env_cfg).unwrapped
The released softvtbench-eval environment contains Isaac Sim 4.5, Isaac Lab 2.1.1 and Python 3.10
The simulator setup installs Isaac Lab 2.1.1 from a separate checkout and then the local tac_manip extension
The evaluation scene and USD assets are hosted in the external eval-assets bundle
The tactile runtime assets are downloaded outside the repository and symlinked into tac_manip/assets/data
The tac_manip install_requires list contains only debugpy, psutil, nvidia-ml-py and pre-commit, with no simulator or device transport package

determinism.notes: reset(seed) records the seed and the kinematic updates are deterministic, so the same actions repeat a trajectory; the fake does not draw the initial pose from the seed, so different seeds may start from the same state

gaps: kinematic stand-in only: no Isaac Sim, no rigid-body contacts, no FEM deformable objects and no actuator, sensor or noise dynamics
the 512x512 RGB and distance-to-image-plane camera arrays of eye_in_hand_cam and agentview_cam are not modelled
the GelSight/FEM tactile arrays and the task-specific USD scene and object assets are not modelled

the differential-IK solver is not modelled: the fake adds the first three pose components to the end-effector position, ignores the three orientation components and leaves the arm joint positions at their start values
goal-success and object-dropped terminations are not modelled; only the 320-step libero_10 time-out is
the default libero_10 task 0 is modelled; another TASK_SUITE or TASK_ID changes the observation terms and the episode length
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by 50 ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the upstream ManagerBasedRLEnv exposes no get_state/set_state
the fake was never compared with a running Isaac Sim environment

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
